purpose: preserve official game-day inactive source bytes around the T-90 release window

capture_policy.reason: cover the official approximately T-90 inactive release plus propagation delay and late corrections while remaining pre-kickoff
capture_policy.unchanged_poll_behavior: append observation referencing existing raw object
